rows.reason: Documented conditional output is disabled in the selected RTL configuration.

review_decisions.reason: Directions and widths align after selecting configured variants: CLK 1-bit to wb_clk_i, WB_ADDR_I 3-bit to wb_adr_i, WB_DAT_I/O 8-bit to wb_dat_i/o, with BAUD_O explicitly inactive per its conditional define and RTL absence.

inactive_spec_ports.BAUD_O: Documented conditional output is disabled in the selected RTL configuration.

assumptions: Guessed choice: CLK maps to wb_clk_i despite name difference; I rejected leaving CLK unmapped because wb_clk_i is the sole 1-bit clock candidate and architecture expects logical-to-physical aliasing.
Outside-knowledge assumption: WB_ADDR_I maps to wb_adr_i via common WISHBONE ADR/ADDR abbreviation convention; I rejected leaving it unmapped because width 3 and input direction match the candidate.

Outside-knowledge assumption: width_choices WB_ADDR_I=3 and WB_DAT_I=8 and WB_DAT_O=8 selected to match RTL inventory widths wb_adr_i 3 and wb_dat_i/o 8; I rejected the 5 and 32 alternatives because they do not match the configured RTL.

Guessed choice: BAUD_O is inactive because UART_HAS_BAUDRATE_OUTPUT is not defined in this DATA_BUS_WIDTH_8 build and it is absent from RTL; I rejected synthesizing a port because conditional absence requires an inactive configuration reason.

relationship_context.authority: Specification defines behavior; RTL defines physical connectivity. Alignment does not promote inferred semantics.
